fusions.name: Thorn Palisade
fusions.desc: A burst of thorns ahead of you deals 8 damage to everything in it, stuns it for 1 second and makes it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Sap Thorn
fusions.desc: Fires a thorn that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Every point of damage Poison deals heals you.

fusions.name: Rootbound Ward
fusions.desc: Raises a growth where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 4 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Deep Roots
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%. It also regenerates 1 health a second, permanently.
